symbols.name: log exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed real number, the power to which the logarithm factor of a near-linear bound is raised.
symbols.quote: Near-linear time is built from the [Logarithm](logarithm.md) $\lg n$: a running time is near-linear when it is $O\big(n(\lg n)^{c}\big)$ for some fixed real exponent $c$, the power to which the logarithm factor is raised.
